title: Shout and whisper
hints: Strings come with built-in helpers you call with a dot, like `text.someMethod()`.
`toUpperCase()` makes every letter big, `toLowerCase()` makes every letter small. Then glue on the ending with `+`.
shout: `return text.toUpperCase() + "!";` — whisper is the same idea with `toLowerCase()` and `"..."`.
